rationale_sources: indexed Introduction and Eq. 4; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Visual evidence and intermediate reasoning constraints can interfere in a monolithic growing context or shared buffer.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Separate parameter subspaces provide specialization capacity and reduce cross-type interference.
analysis_basis: Indexed shared-versus-dual replacement ablation reports a 6.31-point reasoning-average gain.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A single bank is simpler; explicit scratchpads are more inspectable but add text length; semantic purity of either bank is not proven.

sources: indexed disentanglement ablation; extracted_text/search_index_evidence.md

rationale_sources: indexed Section 4.1 Eq. 4; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Per-sample external memory construction and storage would add a write/retrieval subsystem.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Learn reusable latent slots once and contextualize them against each current prefix.
analysis_basis: Eq. 4 explicitly says the banks are input-agnostic and shared; the motive is reviewer inference.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Per-example caches are more specific but heavier; shared banks may become generic templates.

rationale_sources: indexed Eq. 5-7; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Static global latent vectors are not aligned to the current request and decoding state.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Let selected latents attend to current context and project resulting states back to backbone width.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A small cross-attention module could cost less; a replica may be expressive but computationally expensive.

sources: indexed Table 2; extracted_text/search_index_evidence.md

rationale_sources: indexed Section 4.2; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Routing at every token enlarges the action space and control overhead.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Restrict route decisions to structural prefix boundaries.
analysis_basis: The indexed method explicitly states stability and overhead control.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A learned trigger is more flexible; fixed delimiters may miss useful states.

rationale_sources: indexed Section 4.2; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Unbounded routed injections can grow context and latency without a hard worst-case limit.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Stop routing after a fixed count per sample.
analysis_basis: The indexed method specifies the cap as an overhead-control rule.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: A soft cost penalty is more adaptive but provides no hard guarantee.

rationale_sources: indexed Eq. 8-9 and Table 4; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Different decoding states need different evidence types and different injection capacities.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Map the latest hidden state to a discrete pair selecting bank and token budget.
analysis_basis: Adaptive routing reports a better accuracy-token point than the tested fixed budgets.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Continuous mixtures are differentiable but may activate all banks; fixed budgets are predictable but wasteful.

sources: indexed Table 4; extracted_text/search_index_evidence.md

rationale_sources: indexed Section 4.2; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Sampled router actions introduce deployment variance.
analysis_basis: The paper explicitly cites reproducibility; the broader deployment motive is inferred.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Sampling may help hard cases but reduces determinism.

rationale_sources: indexed Eq. 10; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Two latent banks can collapse toward the same representation or align to the wrong teacher role.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Within-branch alignment, cross-branch hinge penalties, and separation discourage collapse.
analysis_basis: The dual-vs-shared result is indirect evidence; no term-level loss ablation was recovered.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Orthogonality or contrastive losses are alternatives; over-separation can remove useful shared structure.

sources: indexed disentanglement ablation; extracted_text/search_index_evidence.md

design_rationales.design: Stage 2 mixed memory types and budgets
rationale_sources: indexed Eq. 11 prose; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: An injector trained on one route condition may fail under other memory types or overhead budgets.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Expose training to varied types and budgets so the interface learns across route conditions.
analysis_basis: The training recipe states the variation, but no matched curriculum ablation was recovered.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Curriculum or exhaustive schedules may be more controlled but more expensive.

design_rationales.design: Stage 3 correctness-gated efficiency GRPO with frozen backbone
rationale_sources: indexed Eq. 12 and Appendix-B prose; analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Accuracy-only optimization can over-inject, while unconditional budget penalties can sacrifice correctness.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Reward smaller budgets only on correct trajectories while regularizing against a reference policy and keeping the base model fixed.
analysis_basis: Table 4 supports the full adaptive system but does not isolate the efficiency-reward term.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Constrained RL or Pareto optimization could expose the frontier; correctness gating may still permit reward gaming.
